settings.label: Enabled
settings.description:
Shows Emby on the main menu
Needs an Emby server: its address in Server Address, then SIGN IN

settings.label: Sign In
settings.description:
Opens Emby to sign in: the server's address and a password, or Emby Connect
Signed in, the user in use

settings.label: Server Address
settings.description:
Your Emby server, as http://192.168.1.10:8096
The sign-in screen fills it in too

settings.label: Video Quality
settings.description:
The most a video is sent at
[DIRECT PLAY] The file as it is, no transcode
[1080P] [720P] Transcoded where larger
[576P] Transcoded where larger: a PAL CRT's lines
[480P] Transcoded where larger: an NTSC CRT's lines

settings.label: Resume Playback
settings.description:
Where a video stopped part-way starts again
[ASK] Asks: from where it stopped, or from the beginning
[ALWAYS] From where it stopped
[NEVER] From the beginning

settings.label: Intro Skip
settings.description: Uses Emby's intro chapter markers when the server has detected them

settings.label: Credit Skip
settings.description: Uses Emby's credit chapter markers when the server has detected them

settings.label: Scaling
settings.description:
How a 16:9 picture fills the 4:3 screen in this module
[DEFAULT] As Settings' Scaling says

settings.label: Sign Out
settings.description: Removes this device from the server and forgets the sign-in here
